summary: Adding the $60 hot-towel shave increased revenue by 190 to 505 while reducing overall visits by 4 to 21. Walkouts dropped dramatically from 10 to 2, and average satisfaction rose 0.2 points to 3.2, suggesting the premium service retained customers who would otherwise have left. Wait time increased 2.6 minutes to 8.6, likely due to the longer service duration, yet this did not deter demand. Regulars drove most of the revenue gain with a 170 jump to 355, while the service cannibalised kids cuts, which fell 3 orders from 7. The new cut-plus-beard combo generated 4 orders that did not exist in baseline, indicating the upgrade attracted upsell-ready customers.
